design.act: test Parpola's fish-sign family sign by sign under the Phase-43 T2.4 ending-follower measure on the strict corpus, repeated on the Holdat layer as a second arm, over family membership fixed in advance by Asset F as frozen at Spec 044's step 0 and consumed by digest assertion at gate 0.1

claim.state: IN QUESTION, partially supported: sign 72 passed Phase-43 T2.4 and sign 267, the family's most frequent member, failed it; that split record is not re-adjudicated by this spec beyond the family verdict of section 6
claim.not_understood: the claim record's not-understood text: the same test run sign by sign across the whole fish family on the strict corpus, with the family's membership fixed in advance

contract_anchor.source: Spec 044's freeze digest, read at this freeze from PR #243's branch (head 66d4fd37) - Spec 044's freeze had not yet merged when read; the value is its corrected freeze digest, superseding its first freeze digest 9a0e6518 under its own pre-merge test repair (its freeze.md section 5)
contract_anchor.contract: Spec 044 section 4: the canonical file asset-f-fish-family.json (UTF-8, keys sorted, members sorted by sign_key, nine required member fields), built solely from Parpola's published list (Parpola 1994, fig. 5.1, pp. 70-78), the digest the SHA-256 of the canonical bytes with the digest field itself excluded

pin_source.posture: the step-0 outcome record is the results JSON deliverable of Spec 044 section 9, produced at Spec 044's execution step 0 (Wave 3); it is the only authoritative statement of Asset F's byte-digest (Spec 044 section 4.4)

asset_f.gate_0_1: at EXECUTION step 0 the exhibited canonical file is recomputed over its exact bytes with the digest field excluded and compared to the digest in the pin source: absence of the file or of the record closes ASSET F NOT AVAILABLE; a mismatch closes ASSET F DIGEST MISMATCH; in neither case is any count computed and the asset is never rebuilt, re-derived, or substituted under this spec

join.via: each Asset F member's mahadevan_number locator, through the pinned Mahadevan-Parpola crosswalk (gate 0.2); locators are never membership criteria
join.unmapped: DD-048-5, confirmed at freeze (DD-048-15): a member carrying no Mahadevan mapping is recorded UNMAPPED, listed in the step-0 record with the reason, and excluded from both arms' weighting; it is never silently dropped and never counted as TOO THIN
join.cross_check: the step-0 record reports Asset F's membership against the claim record's trio (Mahadevan 72, 64, 70) and the Phase-43 six candidates (267, 72, 65, 59, 60, 70), every divergence named; the cross-check adds and removes no member

strict_corpus.reading: the strict corpus is the program's V3 / Mahadevan-lineage corpus of Spec 033 section 4, as held in the database, identified, exported whole, and pinned by digest at gate 0.3; it is not a restriction of counted signs to the 94 strict_sa_independent readings, which would exclude sign 72 itself (DD-048-18)
strict_corpus.closure: if the layer cannot be uniquely identified, cannot be exported whole, or the reference points do not reproduce, the execution closes as STRICT CORPUS NOT PINNABLE and nothing is counted

test.measure: the Phase-43 T2.4 ending-follower rate, unchanged, per mapped Asset F member, in the primary arm and repeated on the Holdat layer as the second arm
test.bar_open: OPEN-048-3 (confirmed at freeze, DD-048-11): the bar sits between sign 72's recorded 0.259 (supported) and sign 267's recorded 0.038 (not supported), exactly as design D-04 fixed it
test.family_rule: over tested members (mapped, at or above the floor), the passing members' token-weighted share of tested occurrences: at least 70% FAMILY SUPPORTED, at most 30% FAMILY NOT SUPPORTED, between or on a cross-arm disagreement about the most frequent tested member INCONCLUSIVE
test.second_arm: integral (DD-048-4, confirmed at freeze as DD-048-12): a Holdat layer or per-sign crosswalk failure closes the execution as SECOND ARM NOT RUNNABLE; crosswalk-conflict pairs are reported separately in both arms, never silently dropped
test.sensitivity: the family verdict recomputed over only signs 72, 64, 70 (Asset F members, mapped, above the floor), reported alongside, never verdict-changing beyond section 6's stated rule

controls.matching_rule: a non-fish animal sign qualifies iff its published animal identification is citable from the program's records, its primary-corpus total is at least 30, and its total lies between half the smallest tested member's total and twice the largest tested member's total; the set is enumerated in the step-0 record at gate 0.6 before any follower quantity is computed
controls.comparison: DD-048-7, confirmed: 'same rate' means the controls' token-weighted passing share at or above the family's; on that case the outcome record reports the fish result as a positional fact, not as support for the reading

design.fences: the Roif hold binds every output (records internal; campaign reporting names this member only as executed - held under the Roif gate, without result content); no outcome establishes what any fish sign was pronounced or meant; no outcome explains why sign 267 behaves differently; sign identities are compilation-relative to the two pinned arms and their crosswalk
design.execution_gate: Execution is Phase-408 under this frozen contract, on a separate owner execution order, and awaits the verified approval of this spec's OSF contract registration (OPEN-048-6; osf-spec-registration.md); no count was made at the freeze itself, Asset F has not been built, no corpus layer has been pinned, and no member is named beyond the record's own reference signs
